ipa.dates_and_calendars.holidays.Definition

Holidays definition object

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.dates_and_calendars.holidays.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    tag: OptStr = None,
    calendars: OptStrStrs = None,
    currencies: OptStrStrs = None,
    holiday_outputs: list[HolidayOutputs] | list[str] | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start_date OptDateTime No None Start date of calculation.
end_date OptDateTime No None End date of calculation.
tag OptStr No None Reference tag to map particular response in payload.
calendars OptStrStrs No None Calendars to use the date for working day or weekend. Optional if currencies is provided.
currencies OptStrStrs No None Currencies to use the date for working day or weekend. Optional if calendars is provided.
holiday_outputs list[HolidayOutputs] | list[str] | None No None In case if test date is holiday you may request additional information about the holiday. Possible options are: Date, Names, Calendars, Countries
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

import datetime
from lseg.data.content.ipa.dates_and_calendars import holidays

definition = holidays.Definition(
  tag="my request",
  start_date=datetime.datetime(2020, 5, 2),
  end_date=datetime.timedelta(-30),
  calendars=["UKR", "FRA"],
  currencies=["EUR"],
  holiday_outputs=["Date", "Names", "Calendars", "Countries"]
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
